study: 2-bit ADC threshold optimization (Part-1, ViT_Max + SoftQuantize) -- SINGLE 5000-epoch convergence run
dataset_units: mV (with sigma=4.64 mV Gaussian noise BAKED into the TFRs)
time_slices: 2t, samples [11,26] of the 101-sample 10ps waveform (200ps convolved) -- the '2 and 5' set
containment: contained = original_atEdge == False (== rawElectronChargeOriginal_atEdge == 0); ~47% of events kept

config.noise_at_load: OFF (noise=-1) -- noise is already BAKED into the TFRs, not added at train time
config.k_anneal: cosine 1->67 stretched over the full 5000 epochs
config.note: data scale max ~644 (matches prior new-3srb set), so the [25,160] window/offset=0 recipe ports directly

result.basis: best checkpoint of one long 5000-epoch run (not a multi-seed median)

convergence.note: each threshold stable to +-0.1..0.2 -- fully converged

comparison_to_clean_archive.interpretation: all three shifted UP (T0 4->12, T1 13->23, T2 47->53) -- the sigma=4.64 mV baked noise raises thresholds off the noise floor for robustness; expected and intended

robustness_note.stuck_init_guard: this dataset's zero-likelihood ceiling is ~98,886, JUST under the old AbortOnStuck thr=1e5, so a stuck seed froze undetected for 379 epochs once. Fixed: thr=1e4 + flat-line (no-improvement-15-ep) detector + reseed loop. Seed 42 escaped on first try (0 stuck retries).

units_note: all NLL values are PER BATCH (sum over the 5000-event val batch), not per event
